Emily — attaching the requested artifacts for the desk review.

Attachments (in Drive and zipped here):
- postmortem_summary_sanitized.pdf — a short, redacted postmortem template showing our timeline and roles (sanitized for auditors).
- sanitized_log_snippet.txt — 12-line sample demonstrating our redaction tokens (IP hashed with salt, email local-parts replaced, account_id hashed).
- redaction_matrix.csv — previously sent (CSV) with explicit handling for email, IP, account ids, usernames.
- redwood_irp_v3.0.pdf — playbook with annotated redactions.

Quick answers to your clarifications:
- Retention: default system logs retained 90 days; audit-grade telemetry retained 2 years for customers with contractual retention clauses. Exports for auditors are generated on request; the export inherits the system retention rules but we stamp the export with generation time and a retention notice (we recommend auditors download and store outside our export window).
- PII handling: emails — local part removed, domain preserved where needed for service-scoped checks; IPs — salted SHA256 hash; account identifiers — one-way hash plus prefix token; timestamps preserved in ISO to preserve sequence for timeline reconstruction. See redaction_matrix.csv for row-level specifics.

We uploaded the zipped evidence bundle to the auditor folder you provided and added a short README. Drive link (auditor access): https://drive.ridgebank-auditors.com/rdb-2028/soc2-evidence/RDB-4532-redwood-bundle.zip

If Ridgebank legal wants the unredacted pack under NDA, please route the NDA to legal@redwood.com and mark the HubSpot ticket HS-12345678 so we can correlate.
